description: Community-extensible DirectMetal game presets. When a game is added to the library for the first time, the first matching profile seeds its per-game settings (never overwriting an existing, user-configured entry). Users can override or extend these presets with ~/Library/Application Support/DirectMetal/game_profiles.json (same schema; profiles with the same id replace bundled ones) or point DIRECTMETAL_GAME_PROFILES at a custom file.

fields.id: Stable lowercase identifier (a-z, 0-9, '-'). Stored on the library entry as profileID.
fields.title: Display name of the game.
fields.matchTitles: Library titles matched case-, space- and punctuation-insensitively ("Need For Speed - Hot Pursuit" == "Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit").
fields.matchExeNames: Executable file names matched case-insensitively. Only list names unique to the game (avoid generic launchers such as start_protected_game.exe).
fields.steamAppIds: Steam app IDs (strings). Matched against the steamAppID discovered from steamapps/appmanifest_*.acf or steam_appid.txt.
fields.retinaMode: true = native Retina backing scale + Retina LogPixels.
fields.enableSandbox: true = run inside the DirectMetal Seatbelt sandbox profile.
fields.status: playable | needs-steam-login | preset (preset = untested community starter template)
fields.notes: Short human-readable explanation shown in the GUI and stored as profileNote.
fields.verifiedOn: Hardware/OS combinations on which a DirectMetal maintainer actually ran the game, or ["preset"] for untested community starter templates.
fields.gameEngine: Engine tag (Unreal Engine 5, Unity, RE Engine, Frostbite 3, REDengine 3/4, Source, Source 2, ...). Informational.
fields.stores: Storefronts the game is sold on and that DirectMetal's scanners recognize: steam | gog | epic.
fields.gogGameIds: GOG Galaxy gameId strings (goggame-<id>.info). Only IDs confirmed for the title are listed.
fields.epicAppNames: Epic Games Store AppName strings (launcher Manifests/*.item, .egstore, Heroic). Only confirmed names are listed.

profiles.title: Hades
profiles.notes: D3D11 via ARM64EC + FEX + Mullion. Measured 120 FPS locked (ProMotion) at native Retina 1512x982 with 0 Seatbelt denials inside the sandbox; MetalFX Quality also measured (111 FPS 1%-low).

profiles.title: REANIMAL
profiles.notes: Unreal Engine 5 D3D12 (FL 12_2) via ARM64EC + FEX + Mullion with the bundled D3D12 placed-resource guard. In-game DLSS is routed to Metal 4 MetalFX Temporal automatically; verified with --sandbox --perf-mode ultra.

profiles.title: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit
profiles.notes: 32-bit D3D9 on native ARM64EC + FEX (macOS 26.4+) with WineMetalGL (wined3d -> Metal): avoids DXVK ddraw freezes and green-tinted FMVs. 22-minute live session, exit=0, zero Rosetta 2.

profiles.title: Team Fortress 2
profiles.notes: 64-bit Source D3D9 via native ARM64X DXVK 3.1.1 (MetalVulkan) -> KosmicKrisp Vulkan -> Metal. Measured 14-19% GPU load (down from 68%), zero Rosetta 2. Online play requires a Steam login.

Prince of Persia - The Forgotten Sands
profiles.notes: 32-bit D3D9 with SteamStub + Ubisoft DRM: launches, then shows a "Steam Error" dialog unless the Windows Steam client in the DirectMetal steam prefix is signed in (no DRM bypass). Not matched by exe name because "Prince of Persia.exe" is shared with other titles.
